card.title: TCP-aware Adaptive Queue Management in Internet Routers

header.team: Congestion Control in Packet Switched Networks

hero.description: A mechanism for TCP-aware adaptive management of queues in Internet routers. Implemented Threshold Based Queuing policy in NS3 simulation, achieving 50% less queuing delay without compromising on throughput compared to drop-tail.

paper.title: A mechanism for TCP-aware adaptive management of queues in Internet routers
